spec.description: Caching proxy for APT package downloads.

spec.title: Hit ratio
spec.description: Cacheable requests only: denied and tunnelled (`CONNECT`) requests are outside the ratio.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/apt-squid"} |~ " (TCP|UDP|NONE)_[A-Z_]+/[0-9]{3} " | regexp `^\S+\s+\d+\s+(?P<client>\S+)\s+(?P<action>[A-Z_]+)/(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<size>\d+)\s+\S+\s+(?:[a-z]+://)?(?P<dsthost>[^/\s:]*)(?::\d+)?\S*\s+\S+\s+[A-Z_]+/\S+` | client!="127.0.0.1" | client=~`$client` | dsthost=~`$dsthost` | action=~`TCP_.*HIT.*|TCP_REFRESH_UNMODIFIED.*` [$__range]))
/
(sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/apt-squid"} |~ " (TCP|UDP|NONE)_[A-Z_]+/[0-9]{3} " | regexp `^\S+\s+\d+\s+(?P<client>\S+)\s+(?P<action>[A-Z_]+)/(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<size>\d+)\s+\S+\s+(?:[a-z]+://)?(?P<dsthost>[^/\s:]*)(?::\d+)?\S*\s+\S+\s+[A-Z_]+/\S+` | client!="127.0.0.1" | client=~`$client` | dsthost=~`$dsthost` | action=~`TCP_.*` | action!~`TCP_DENIED.*|TCP_TUNNEL.*` [$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Requests by cache action
spec.description:
Denied requests are on the Denials tab.

- `TCP_MEM_HIT`, `TCP_HIT` — served from memory or disk
- `TCP_REFRESH_UNMODIFIED` — revalidated upstream, cached copy reused
- `TCP_MISS`, `TCP_REFRESH_MODIFIED` — fetched fresh bytes
- `TCP_TUNNEL` — `CONNECT` passthrough, never cached
- `NONE_NONE` — the proxy could not parse the request

spec.expr: sum by (action) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/apt-squid"} |~ " (TCP|UDP|NONE)_[A-Z_]+/[0-9]{3} " | regexp `^\S+\s+\d+\s+(?P<client>\S+)\s+(?P<action>[A-Z_]+)/(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<size>\d+)\s+\S+\s+(?:[a-z]+://)?(?P<dsthost>[^/\s:]*)(?::\d+)?\S*\s+\S+\s+[A-Z_]+/\S+` | client!="127.0.0.1" | client=~`$client` | dsthost=~`$dsthost` | action!~`TCP_DENIED.*` [$__auto]))

spec.description:
Newest 1000 lines of the access log and Squid's cache log.
- The store log and requests from `127.0.0.1` are dropped.
- Each line's epoch timestamp is stripped, leaving `elapsed client action/status bytes method url user hierarchy/peer type`.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="docker/apt-squid"} !~ `^\S+ (RELEASE|SWAPOUT|SWAPIN) ` | regexp `^\S+\s+\d+\s+(?P<client>\S+)\s+(?P<action>[A-Z_]+)/(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<size>\d+)\s+\S+\s+(?:[a-z]+://)?(?P<dsthost>[^/\s:]*)(?::\d+)?\S*\s+\S+\s+[A-Z_]+/\S+` | client!="127.0.0.1" | client=~`$client` | dsthost=~`$dsthost` | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\s+" __line__ "" }}` | drop transport, systemd_unit, project, hostname

sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/apt-squid"} !~ `^\S+ (RELEASE|SWAPOUT|SWAPIN) ` | regexp `^\S+\s+\d+\s+(?P<client>\S+)\s+(?P<action>[A-Z_]+)/(?P<status>\d+)\s+(?P<size>\d+)\s+\S+\s+(?:[a-z]+://)?(?P<dsthost>[^/\s:]*)(?::\d+)?\S*\s+\S+\s+[A-Z_]+/\S+` | client!="127.0.0.1" | client=~`$client` | dsthost=~`$dsthost` [$__interval]))
